messages.text: Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: a word from the residents.
The drill struck water: a decision is waiting.
Supply drop landed: colonists 6, earth rations 85, metal 25, brick 10, machinery 3, electronics 3, soil 15.
The aquifer on floor 2 is tapped: deep well pumps can draw on it.
Teodor Novak is waiting at the office: room demand: a clinic.
Sana Reyes is waiting at the office: the residents want it fixed.

kept.message: The clinic is open. {name} is telling everyone you kept your word.

broken.message: Still no clinic. {name} is telling everyone you broke your word.

kept.message: {name} thanks you, for the residents, for fixing it ({what}).

broken.message: {name} says you broke your promise to the residents to fix it ({what}).
